examples.claim: The assessment value is recorded in the manual-review band.
examples.heading: Individual automatic-processing bands
examples.quote: The credit score is automatically processed at 700 or above, manually reviewed from 580 to 699, and declined below 580.

examples.claim: Scores from 580 to 649 proceed with a 25% limit reduction and dual sign-off.
examples.heading: Credit bureau and score thresholds
examples.quote: Scores between 580 and 649 may only proceed under the exceptions policy (POL-CR-005) with a mandatory 25% limit reduction and dual sign-off.

examples.claim: The servicing ratio cap is 55% of qualifying income.
examples.heading: Total debt servicing ratio for individuals
examples.quote: All individual borrowers are subject to a total debt servicing ratio (TDSR) cap of 55% of gross monthly qualifying income.

examples.claim: Breach of the cap cannot be cured by exception.
examples.heading: Total debt servicing ratio for individuals
examples.quote: Breach of the 55% cap is a hard decline and cannot be cured by exception.

examples.claim: Every exception needs dual sign-off one level above standard authority.
examples.heading: Exception limits and dual control
examples.quote: Every exception requires dual sign-off at least one level above the standard approval authority for that amount.

examples.claim: Two or more breached rules require the credit committee.
examples.heading: Exception limits and dual control
examples.quote: Single-rule breaches only: cases breaching 2 or more policy rules require credit committee approval regardless of amount.

examples.claim: The unsecured floor is 1.25x.
examples.heading: Debt service coverage ratio for business borrowers
examples.quote: Small-business term facilities require a debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) of at least 1.25x, computed as adjusted EBITDA divided by total annual debt service including the proposed facility.

examples.claim: A ratio between 1.0x and the floor proceeds as a 12-month reviewable facility with quarterly covenant testing.
examples.heading: Debt service coverage ratio for business borrowers
examples.quote: DSCR between 1.0x and the applicable floor may proceed only as a 12-month reviewable facility with quarterly covenant testing.

examples.claim: The servicing ratio is manually reviewed above 35% and up to 50%.
examples.heading: Individual automatic-processing bands
examples.quote: The total debt servicing ratio is automatically processed at or below 35%, manually reviewed above 35% and up to 50%.

examples.claim: The servicing ratio is manually reviewed above 35% and up to 50% with a 55% hard cap.
examples.heading: Individual automatic-processing bands
examples.quote: The total debt servicing ratio is automatically processed at or below 35%, manually reviewed above 35% and up to 50%.

examples.claim: Scores from 580 to 649 proceed with a 25% limit reduction and team manager sign-off.
examples.heading: Credit bureau and score thresholds
examples.quote: Scores between 580 and 649 may only proceed under the exceptions policy (POL-CR-005) with a mandatory 25% limit reduction and dual sign-off.

examples.claim: A ratio of 1.20x meets the 1.15x secured floor.
examples.heading: Debt service coverage ratio for business borrowers
examples.quote: Secured facilities with qualifying collateral may use a 1.15x floor.

examples.claim: Start-ups qualify for unsecured facilities at 50% of the standard limit.
examples.heading: Business eligibility and trading history
examples.quote: Start-ups between 12 and 24 months old qualify only for secured facilities capped at 50% of the standard limit with a full director guarantee.

examples.claim: Scores below 580 may proceed with a pricing uplift.
examples.heading: Credit bureau and score thresholds
examples.quote: Scores between 580 and 649 may only proceed under the exceptions policy (POL-CR-005) with a mandatory 25% limit reduction and dual sign-off. Scores below 580 are an automatic decline.

examples.claim: The automatic-processing amount is at most S$25,000 for individual facilities.
examples.heading: Individual automatic-processing bands
examples.quote: The automatic-processing amount is at most S$15,000.

examples.claim: Trading history of 1.5 years is eligible for automatic processing.
examples.heading: SME automatic-processing bands
examples.quote: Trading history below 1 year is a decline, 1 year up to but not including 2 years is manually reviewed, and 2 years or more is eligible for automatic processing.

examples.claim: The facility is approved.
examples.heading: Exception limits and dual control
examples.quote: Every exception requires dual sign-off at least one level above the standard approval authority for that amount.

examples.claim: The claim has no usable quote.
examples.heading: Individual automatic-processing bands

examples.claim: The ratio sits in a reviewed band.
examples.heading: Individual automatic-processing bands

examples.claim: The mitigant stack applies with a 20% reduction under team manager sign-off.
examples.heading: Pricing and structural mitigants
examples.quote: Approved exceptions carry a minimum pricing uplift of 50 basis points above the standard risk-based price, a 20% limit reduction versus the applied amount, and reviewable 12-month tenor with quarterly covenant testing.
